1631: Una seta capaz de cambiar el aspecto de los Pokémon al dinamaxizarse. Aumenta todas las características de un Pokémon si se usa en combate.
Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.
1632: Una rama de un árbol llamado Galanuez, que crece en determinadas zonas de Galar. Con ella se pueden crear accesorios para cierto Pokémon.

1633: Un brazalete hecho de Ramas de Galanuez trenzadas. Los Slowpoke de Galar se ponen contentísimos si lo reciben como regalo.
A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.
1634: Una tarjeta que aumenta la selección de artículos disponibles en las tiendas y permite elegir entre una mayor variedad de peinados en las peluquerías.
A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.
1635: Un pase que permite viajar hasta la Isla de la Armadura. Hay que mostrárselo al empleado de la estación de Pueblo Par.
A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.
1636: Gracias al poder de Rotom, esta bicicleta permite usar el turbo y desplazarse sobre el agua. Tiene un color blanco centelleante.
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that shines brilliantly.
1637: Gracias al poder de Rotom, esta bicicleta permite usar el turbo y desplazarse sobre el agua. De color negro y con una fulgurante estela rojinegra.
This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that shines reddish-black.
1638: Amuleto que aumenta los Puntos de Experiencia que reciben los Pokémon. Su interior contiene una especie de mecanismo.
A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.
1639: Un mineral poco común que se encuentra en la Isla de la Armadura. Tal vez ocurra algo bueno al dárselo a un coleccionista de dicha isla.
Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.
1640: Misterioso y particular amuleto que aumenta las posibilidades de encontrar Pokémon con emblemas.
A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.
1641: Riendas que se entregaron como ofrenda al rey. Potencian los poderes de Calyrex para mejorar las cosechas y le permiten unirse con su amado corcel.
Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.
1642: Riendas que se entregaron como ofrenda al rey. Permiten el entendimiento mutuo entre aquellos que están unidos y separan a Calyrex de su amado corcel.
Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.
1643: Una corona hecha de Ramas de Galanuez trenzadas. Los Slowpoke de Galar se ponen contentísimos cuando la llevan puesta.
A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.
1644: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda del Rey de las Cosechas. Lleva adjunta una vieja fotografía.
A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.
1645: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda de los gigantes. Contiene unas ilustraciones muy particulares.
A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.
1646: Una nota escrita por Peony acerca de la leyenda de las aves legendarias. Contiene una ilustración muy particular.
A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.
1647: Una extraña nota que se le cayó a Peony. Tiene pegada una foto del Supernido Dinamax en la que se ve una cavidad luminosa.
A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.
1648: Un pase que permite viajar hasta las Nieves de la Corona. Hay que mostrárselo al empleado de la estación de Pueblo Par.
A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.
1649: Un misterioso objeto hecho de madera. Las marcas que presenta parecen indicar que no está completo, como si formase parte de algo.
A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.
1650: Un pétalo recibido del Rey de las Cosechas. Emite una luz tenue.
A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.
1651: Parte de la crin de Glastrier, el amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas. Es flexible y resistente.
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.
1652: Parte de la crin de Spectrier, el amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas. Es suave al tacto.
Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.
1653: Una zanahoria cultivada en un huerto rebosante de nieve. Es la hortaliza preferida del amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas.

1654: Una zanahoria cultivada en un huerto sombrío. Es la hortaliza preferida del amado corcel del Rey de las Cosechas.
Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

1711: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely with oilier foods and works especially well when you add just a pinch for a hint of flavor.
1712: A condiment that's very sweet and very sour. It goes especially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into a sandwich.

1715: A condiment that's very sweet and likewise very sour. Take care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet side can overwhelm.
1716: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It's surprisingly useful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

1721: This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super effective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion. Only a scant few people know it exists.
1722: A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It's said to dramatically bolster a body's immune defenses, though that hasn't been proven.
1723: The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of all spicy flavors. It's said that a single bite will kick the metabolism into high gear immediately.

1725: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements to it, making it popular with many Pokémon.
1726: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very sweet, and these are prized above all others by the people of Paldea.
1727: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich-tasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the most of a cucumber's fresh-veggie aroma.
1728: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies in a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.
1729: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches. It goes well with rich ingredients.
1730: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and fragrance are milder than those of other onions, making it a pleasant bite.
1731: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds a nice accent to a sandwich.
1732: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes and overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its green cousin.
1733: An ingredient with some bitterness. It's not much different from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing the colors makes a feast for the eyes.
1734: An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is very mild. The avocado's richness, however, makes it satisfying to eat.
1735: This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of charred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.
1736: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what makes it such a nice companion to veggies.
1737: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the difference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured, giving it a fun freshness.
1738: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage has particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier varieties are extra popular.
1739: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between the potent saltiness and the herbs' bitterness make this sausage a pleasure.
1740: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want to make your sandwich truly filling.
1741: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It's a nutritious processed food made with a concentrate derived from shed Klawf shells.
1742: A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable smoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.
1743: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter ingredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.
1744: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It's full of nutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.
1745: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea. It's undeniably filling.
1746: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.
1747: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.
1748: A nice salty ingredient. It's unclear how well these boiled noodles will serve as a sandwich filling.
1749: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that's all about potatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.
1750: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is perfect for adding to a sandwich.
1751: A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and rich, and it's beloved by many Pokémon.
1752: A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability to make a sandwich visually striking.
1753: This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy to add into a sandwich.
1754: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness as well. It goes well with rich ingredients.
1755: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands, and its color and texture are a thrill. It's been cut into chunks to be easily manageable.
1756: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room for ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don't.
1757: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in your sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.
1758: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much of this potent seasoning, and it'll cancel out the other flavors.
1759: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at first, but you'll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.
